findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File system operations in certifi
 * @description Looking for file reads/writes that could be vulnerable to path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/file-system-operations
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // File open operations
  call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "read", "write", "remove", "unlink"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember(["Path", "open"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("io").getMember(["open"]).getACall()
select call, "File system operation that could be vulnerable to path traversal if using untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: File system operations that could be vulnerable to path traversal attacks
